verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for a product analytics platform, but the evidence pack never documents user-defined rules or triggers that fire actions when events occur. The closest items describe agents that 'monitor your product continuously' and surface insights, plus export, query and MCP access APIs. These are adjacent monitoring or data-access features, not a rule-to-action automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
